title: Programming Feedback
closedMessage: Feedback is paused right now. You can still email hello@badgersupports.org.
intro: Thank you for coming to Badger Supports programming. Your feedback helps us grow, improve and support our team. Your name is optional, and we don't ask for an email.

sections.intro: Thanks for joining a craft night. These events are about connection, creativity and care.

questions.label: What did you enjoy? Any suggestions — meeting people, the craft, the instructions, the food?

questions.label: What stood out to you? Anything you'd like to see in the future?
